summary: Sloping kerb where cars park, but homes sit 12-15 m behind it.

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 12 m and a detached house 15 m on this side; most other stretches have homes within 6-9 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parked-car lane along this kerb; a van fits among the parked cars.
drivers.traffic: Residential street off a main road; local traffic only.
drivers.convention: Many cars park here, but 2P resident-permit signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Steep: about 5.5% here, 11% mean over the whole stretch, 23% max
No Stopping sign near the Raven Street end
sun_shade: Tall street trees shade the kerb from the south and west for part of the day.

best_section.where: Mid-block on Depper Street north kerb, between the apartments and the detached house
